notes.title: Remove Training for now
notes.notes: Just removed the training mode. Guess no one needs it.

notes.title: Patch Note May.05.2020
notes.notes:
Update Node

* Item Shield now has a fade animation when use.
* Jump 3 times to charge one bullet.
* Standing still will show current number of building slot.
* Item will show up head when picked up.
* Menu text was replaced with symbols.
* The difficulty of training become lower.
* Few bugs fixed.
